newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank o/n rates, one-week widen.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank o/n rates, one-week widen.

text.p: The range of overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened on Thursday in a short private sector market to between 6-3/4 and 8-1/2 percent from Wednesday's range of 7-5/8 and 8-1/4 percent, bankers said.
The one-week range also widened to between 7-1/4 and 8-1/2 percent from 7-7/8 and 8-1/2 percent on Wednesday.
Many bankers attributed the shortage to Wednesday's 91-day treasury bill auction, when the Central Bank of Egypt accepted bids worth 1.387 billion pounds ($408.55 million).
"Many non-public banks were accepted in this auction," one banker said.
Bankers said that public sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
